status: Page classification settings. 2026-10-25: the old BERT + keyword ladder is gone; the Extracted page type is the page axes (axes, axes_rules: page_classify/axes.py, page_rules.py) in the page taxonomy's names (page_taxonomy.json); the Final page type is decided per continuity document (inside_progress_note, final_placement, document_agreement: page_classify/arbitration.py decide_final). bert_* / keyword_* columns of page_classification are no longer filled.

confidence.comment: The keyword canon's own confidence (axes canon_min / l3_canon_min compare against it): keyword_title_base for a title hit, else keyword_body_base, plus keyword_per_margin per point of margin over the next candidate, capped at keyword_title_cap / keyword_body_cap.

inside_progress_note.comment: Final rules (imaging_final, arbitration.decide_final). A page whose Final family becomes the section L1 (Progress Note) — continuing a Progress Note document, or embedded_families on a page headed by a Progress Note title — takes the document's codability, except a page carrying one of non_codeable_names (any of its canon page type / L3 / L2 / L1), which stays Non-Codable. Its Final L2 is final_placement['Progress Note'][its own L1] (Lab Report -> Lab and Imaging Results), else Others.

document_agreement.comment: Across a continuity document every page takes the first page's L1 (sub-types stay per page). Only when the first page is Unknown or Others (neither the model nor the canon was sure), a vote of the pages' L1s weighted by page-type confidence decides, Others pages left out. The vote counts only when one L1 holds at least vote_min_share of the weight; below that the pages keep their own types and are flagged for review (no_agreement). An Others page then takes the document's L1 with the L2 the page classifier gave it there (under_l1), else <L1> / Others.

level_3_continuation.what: On the continuity stage's documents (continuity_canon.json), in imaging_final: every page of a document takes its first page's L1; a page of another L1 is re-placed under it (final_placement, under_l1, else Others). Only when the first page is Unknown / Others does a confidence-weighted vote decide (document_agreement). A page in no multi-page document keeps its own type, except embedded_same_page (a page of an embedded_families L1 with a Progress Note title on it).

axes.comment: The page axes, the Extracted page type: page_classification.page_type / page_subtype (L1 / Others, L1 / L2, or 'L1 (L2)' / L3), the category, and the whole answer in page_classification.axes (and staging/page_classification.json). 1. The model's top 3: for each of its three best L1s, its best L2 and L3 under it with the score p(L1)p(L2|L1)p(L3|L2) (axes.model_top3); the first wins when route is 'model' = top L1 >= route_model, ahead of the second by >= route_margin, not the folded OTHER class ('canon' = OTHER or >= route_canon, else 'review'); its L2 at >= l2_min (an L2 the model folded to Others lets the canon try first). 2. Else the keyword canon (page_canon.json, in the taxonomy's names): the best L1 among its entries at keyword confidence >= canon_min, the best L2 under it likewise -- it names page types the model was never trained on. 3. Else Others (decided_by others). Section_L1 (Progress Note) takes no L2 here: its L2 is the content section. Then axes_rules may re-place the page. L3: always the canon's best L3 under L1 > L2 at l3_canon_min; the model's L3 is kept in model_top3 / prediction. Specialty: the model's when not one of specialty_not_asserted, >= specialty_min, ahead of the second by >= specialty_lead, trained on >= specialty_min_train_pages pages; else the canon entry's. Codeability: always the canon's -- the tag of the canon page type behind the decided path; needs_review when its rule is context (the Final step resolves it from the page's document) or source; a rule's own when the canon has no entry there. axes.sources says who decided each level (model / canon / rule / others / -), axes.decided_by the L1's. taxonomy_version: the model folder's label_space.json must carry it, else the model is refused and the canon decides.

axes_rules.comment: 2026-10-25: rules the axes gate applies after the model and the canon (page_classify/page_rules.py). The first that fires sets L1 / L2 (axes.sources 'rule', axes.rules its name); L3 and codeability are then looked up under the new path, and codeability falls back to the rule's own when the canon has no entry there. Title rules read the title zone: the first title_zone_lines non-empty lines and the OCR's detected headings; a title counts when a line starts with it. Not implemented, pending a decision (2026-10-24 note, section F): ambulatory surgery centre wording -> Outpatient (F2F) encounter; payer record-retrieval fax covers and EHR import covers as junk.

clinical_summary.comment: context_rules.clinical_summary: decided by the document title, never by a phrase inside a note. A Discharge Summary page keeps its path (a hospital packet page titled Clinical Summary). Pages inside the summary without the title take the path from the Final step (the document's first page).

records_request.comment: context_rules.records_request: defined by purpose (letter, fax or EHR note), read from its title.
titles: Request for Copies of Medical Records

superbill.comment: context_rules.superbill: an encounter form or superbill (visit date, provider, ICD-10 and CPT codes). By title only: invoices and statements carry codes too.

hospital_stay.comment: context_rules.admission_history_and_physical / inpatient_consultation: an H&P or consult belongs to the stay only for an inpatient / observation / short stay. Applied to a page that came out Progress Note, titled H&P or Consultation, with stay evidence on the page itself. Not applied the other way (a model's Discharge Summary > H&P without evidence on the page stays): the evidence may sit on another page of the admission.

lab_guard.comment: 2026-10-24 note section C: the model (or the canon) says Progress Note, but the page has no note-body section and carries lab-result markers -> Lab Report. note_body is the labelling regex. Markers count once each; min_lab_markers of them, or a panel title (CBC, CMP, ... followed by final / result / panel / report) on one of the first panel_title_lines lines.

final_placement.comment: 2026-10-25: Final L2 of a page whose own L1 differs from its document's: final_placement[document L1][page L1] (context_rules: page_essence keeps the page's own label in Extracted; the document view is Final — a Lab Report > Pathology Report page inside a Progress Note is Progress Note / Lab and Imaging Results; absorb_into_progress_note; procedure_in_operative_document). A pair not listed: under the Progress Note, Others; under any other L1, the L2 the page classifier gave the page there (axes.under_l1: the model's, else the canon's), else its own name when that L1 has it, else Others. Never L1 / L1.
